views.title: Seam sign-set cells (rule 4)
views.prose: Orientations of the four scorable cells and K⁺Gdm⁺ 8 Å (held out, scored apart), 140 per cell: the 30 most attractive for P and for C0 plus a random draw. The reference is the **Coulomb oracle** k/d², not DFT. Colour by the arm's F_B/Coulomb; arrows are the seed-14 EMA forces of P (blue) and C0 (red), ×2 Å per eV/Å.

views.title: Eight-frame adversarial sign set
views.prose: The frames the overshoot rule (≤ 1.5× oracle at 7.5–9 Å) is read on. Reference is the Coulomb oracle.

views.title: Pairs gate: set-B held-out charged pairs (DFT)
views.prose: DFT-labelled pair scans 4–14 Å (the gate scores r ≥ 8 Å). Arrows: the DFT force (×2) and P seed 14's error (×10). K⁺MeCN, NH₄⁺Cl⁻ and NH₄⁺NH₄⁺ are pair types present in P's training rows (different geometries).

views.title: Type-held-out charged-pair gate (DFT)
views.prose: K⁺Gdm⁺, Gdm⁺I⁻ and Gdm⁺Mg²⁺: pair types absent from every training row, 6 orientation scans per type × 13 distances (6–14 Å), plus the 4 monomers. Gdm⁺ is the common partner, and the other partner is an atom, so orientation variety is the Gdm⁺ rotation only. C0 and P are means of 5 EMA files (H100 s13 + GH200 13r–16; 13 and 13r are same-seed replicates). Arrows: DFT force (×2), P seed-14 and PET-OMol-S errors (×10).

views.title: Ion–water cluster ladders
views.prose: Vertical binding energy dE(n) = E[X·W_n] − E[W_n] − E[X], error against DFT, per held-out centre. The gate is the slope of this error for n ≥ 24 (±0.02 eV per water).

views.title: NaCl(aq) cut-outs: charges per atom
views.prose: Eight spherical cut-outs of a 1 m NaCl(aq) box. Per-atom DFT Löwdin and model latent charges (P and C0, seed 14 EMA), with the DFT forces as arrows (×1). The ion-shell gate (≤ 0.2 e) reads the whole-water shells of the interior ions.

views.title: NaCl droplet (nacl1): charges and forces per atom
views.prose: One 302-atom droplet with DFT forces (arrows ×1) and Löwdin charges, against the P and C0 seed-14 EMA charges and per-atom force errors. It feeds the droplet F MAE of the condensed-phase family.

views.title: Orientation rows (orient4)
views.prose: Charged pairs at 8–12 Å in several orientations, scored for the far-field force spread (the q95 |ΔF| metrics of the seam family). No DFT reference; arrows are P seed-14 EMA forces (×2).

views.title: val500 (every 5th structure)
views.prose: The near-equilibrium accuracy gate (V1: val500 F MAE ≤ 42 meV/Å). Arrows: DFT forces (×1).

views.title: NH4+-Gdm+ scan through the seam
views.prose: A rigid scan; the model energy minus the bare Coulomb term should be flat beyond the cutoff. No DFT reference: this tests the seam handover, not the energy.

views.title: Li+Na+ scan through the seam
views.prose: A rigid scan; the model energy minus the bare Coulomb term should be flat beyond the cutoff. No DFT reference: this tests the seam handover, not the energy.

views.title: MD-stability starting clusters
views.prose: Na⁺, Cl⁻ and Mg²⁺ with 48 or 200 waters (open boundary): the share of each model's runs from this start (250–400 K) judged stable. No forces are stored for these starts.

views.title: charge_parity (reference only)
views.prose: Charge parity: the same structure at several total charges. 27 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: dimers_q2 (reference only)
views.prose: Dimers with a doubly charged fragment. 48 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: emulation (reference only)
views.prose: The emulation set (DFT pathologies a model must reproduce). 94 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: families_full (reference only)
views.prose: Families (full ΔE, every member). 160 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: families_corrected (reference only)
views.prose: Families, corrected labels. 160 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: pathology_h2o2p (reference only)
views.prose: The H₂O₂⁺ pathology (DFT state ambiguity; never scored). 5 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: pbe0mbd_subset (reference only)
views.prose: PBE0+MBD subset (another level of theory). 120 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: maps2d (reference only)
views.prose: 2-D maps. 150 records, DFT forces as arrows (×1) and Löwdin charges per atom. Not part of the long-range score; shown so every structure the benchmark carries can be inspected.

views.title: 1-D scans: type-held-out charged pairs (DFT)
views.prose: 234 frames: 18 rigid scans (K⁺Gdm⁺, Gdm⁺I⁻, Gdm⁺Mg²⁺ × 6 orientations), wB97M-V forces. Arrow sets F_DFT, F_PETOMOLS, F_C0, F_P, F_AL (2.5 Å per eV/Å; type several names, comma separated, in the structure panel's shape field). Gdm⁺Mg²⁺ is flagged `apart_from_aggregates`. AL = one seed (screen).

views.title: 1-D scans: set-B gate pairs (DFT)
views.prose: 312 frames: K⁺MeCN, NH₄⁺Cl⁻, NH₄⁺NH₄⁺ (6 orientations each) and the neutral H₂O·H₂O pair (apart). Same arrow sets and properties as above.

views.title: 1-D scans: sign-set cells, 0.05 Å (no DFT)
views.prose: 252 frames: 3 orientations of Gdm⁺Gdm⁺, NH₄⁺NH₄⁺, NH₄⁺Gdm⁺ and K⁺Gdm⁺ scanned through 6–11 Å. No DFT: compare the net force on B with the Coulomb reference k/d². Model arrows only.
